Description:
"The following observations were identified during the inspection of the MCC Room at the UPDT Plant:

1.The MCC room door was found in an open condition.
2.The temperature inside the MCC room was observed to be higher than the normal room temperature due to the air conditioner (A/C) not functioning properly.

5.The power cable of the pedestal fan was lying on the floor, creating a potential slip, trip, and fall hazard."
Action1:
Engineering-"1.Keep the MCC room door closed at all times except during authorized entry/exit.
2.Repair or replace the non-functional A/C unit immediately to maintain the required room temperature.
3.Ensure the pedestal fan is operational when required for ventilation.
4.Display the names of authorized personnel prominently at the MCC room entrance.
5.Route and secure the pedestal fan cable properly using cable protectors or cable trays to eliminate trip hazards."

Type: Unsafe Condition, Housekeeping, Slip /trip/ fall Hazard
Description:
"The UPDT plant has two MCC rooms with an approximate height difference of 1.5 feet between them. No proper step, staircase, or access platform has been provided for personnel movement between these rooms. This condition creates a significant trip and fall hazard and may result in serious incidents such as First Aid Cases (FAC), Recordable Work Cases (RWC), or Lost Time Injuries (LTI).

It was also observed that a similar incident had been reported previously, and the CAPA identified from the LFI (Learning From Incident) was not implemented horizontally across all applicable locations, resulting in the recurrence of the same unsafe condition."
Action1:
Engineering-"1.Provide a permanent step, staircase, or access platform between the two MCC rooms.and Install caution signage and barricading until the permanent solution is implemented.
2.Conduct a horizontal deployment review of all LFI-related CAPAs across the plant.
3.Verify the effectiveness of CAPA implementation through periodic safety audits.
4.Include this observation in the plant hazard register and track it to closure."
